evidence_labels.source_proven_facts: Location and lexical identity copied from the pinned source inventory.
evidence_labels.audit_recorded_facts: Prior audit classifications copied without revalidation by this planning tool.
evidence_labels.inferred_implementation_plan: Proposed destination, tests, and oracle work; it is not implementation or validation evidence.

thermo_tpx_equilibrium.purpose: Thermodynamic models, real-fluid TPX models, and equilibrium algorithms.

kinetics_interfaces_transport.purpose: Reaction kinetics, reacting interfaces, and transport models.

numerics_zeroD_oneD.purpose: Numerical kernels, reactor ODE systems, and one-dimensional domains.

parser_api_provenance_tests.purpose: Core utilities, parsers, language APIs, audit evidence, examples, and tests.

assignment_policy: Scientific source subsystems map directly to their implementation lane. Base utilities, bindings, extensions, examples, and test-only symbols map to parser_api_provenance_tests. Unknown labels remain there pending audit.
